title: LIVE CLOUD COVER
freshness_label: LIVE / CURRENT MODEL (hourly HRRR cycle, 15-min steps)
source_name: NOAA/NCEP HRRR 3 km TCDC total cloud cover, entire-atmosphere analysis (hourly cycles + 15-min subhourly steps)
variable: TCDC entire atmosphere, analysis step (filed % as-is, no conversion)
coverage: Basin rectangle lon -93..-73.5, lat 40.5..49.5 (all Great Lakes + land). No shoreline cut: full rectangle stays visible.
transparency: Clear sky (<1%) and missing data are fully transparent (alpha 0). Only cloudy pixels paint, dark-blue (thin) to dark-purple (overcast).
what: Hourly HRRR cloud analysis: how much of the sky over the Great Lakes basin is cloud-covered right now, in percent as filed by NOAA. Clear areas are transparent so the map underneath shows through.
why_extreme: Overcast (near 100%) compresses into violet/dark-purple; thin cloud owns most of the color resolution.
